notes: This leaf continues an identification with the Galois group Gal(K-bar/K), gives alternative Gamma notation, and states independence of the chosen proper regular model for the displayed quotient group attached to a finite-type field extension. This describes the page content; it is not a proof verification.
The whole page, both supplied native halves, and all eleven saved contextual crops were visually inspected. No OCR, PDF text layer, external research, other page, or TeX compilation was used.
Only the supplied mark M0071 appears in decisions. The three nested doubts inside C deletions are retained separately in doubts and are not assigned invented mark IDs.

One actual departure from witness C is proposed: equals becomes simeq in the Spec expression. The tilde on Y follows C against H. Retaining or reordering uncertainty would not be counted as a change of witness-C base text; no such artificial count is made here.

H's editorial note claims des modèles / X choisis, although its own running transcription is singular. The ink supports du modèle / X choisi, with no separate final s after either word. The editorial note is not source text and is not copied into the candidate.
H's uncertainty wrappers around et qu'il and ext. do not alter their base readings. The native halves support those words; no extra collation row is made for certainty alone.

The insertion leader above the Gamma line is not parenthesis punctuation. The other insertion leader comes down at the end of Soit, before K. Both attachments have been preserved separately from the uncertain content of the short word.

The three cancelled interiors are not resolved: apparent E_Y, tel and p remain explicitly doubtful. The darker retracing of the live E_Y on the Gamma line is not treated as an additional recoverable underlying character.

The closing underline starts after qui, covers ne through modèle, and continues under X choisi on the following baseline. There is no supplied terminal full stop after connu because no such punctuation is visible.

Formula index/exponent ordering differences in the witness TeX are not content differences. The written Gamma and E expressions were checked on the native halves, and the Gamma insertion was checked again in its crop.
Author number 57 and the thinner bottom foliation 114 are distinct written elements. The foliation is retained with margin, not author-page numbering.
No independent mathematical proof, computation, or formal certificate was attempted. checks is intentionally empty.

Root widened blind box b06 upward from y1004 to y976 before freezing, to avoid clipping the tall letters of its target line. This does not change the original saved crop or its recorded evidence coordinates.

Independent audit: the first quoted modele is unaccented; the wider context shows no omitted accent above it, while the later underlined modèle on the same page is accented. Both witnesses supplied the accent to the first occurrence. The short-form spelling is kept occurrence by occurrence.
